title: Voice translation for one particular community
description: A spoken conversation on a single language pair, with what each direction can do stated plainly.

blocks.text: The user in the example did not get a voice mode for his language. That is a reason to test a narrow specialization, not to promise support for a community on the strength of one review. First you have to find out whether suitable recognition and playback are available and whether they cope with everyday lines.

quote.text: Persian and many more languages are not available in voice mode not benifited

blocks.text: Start with the chosen language pair and with real situations of communication. Separate text, recognition, playback and access without a connection clearly.
Test with native speakers and with different ways of speaking. Do not promise support for a whole language on the strength of a few short phrases.
